Risk_Statement: Because MFA is not consistently enforced for every user, an external threat actor may carry out credential stuffing or phishing, leading to account takeover, corporate mailbox fraud, or confidential data exposure.
Planned_Action: Enforce MFA for all users, disable legacy authentication, and verify sign-in coverage

Risk_Statement: Because access rights are not reviewed on a quarterly basis, a former user or over-privileged account may retain active system permissions, leading to unauthorized sensitive-data access or internal data leaks.
Planned_Action: Create quarterly access review and joiner-mover-leaver checklist

Risk_Statement: Because system patching is conducted manually on an ad-hoc basis, a threat actor may exploit an unpatched known operating system vulnerability, leading to a full critical server compromise or service disruption.
Planned_Action: Define 14-day critical-patch target, scan the server, patch, and rescan

Risk_Statement: Because cloud-storage access lacks structural review records, a misconfigured access control policy may inadvertently expose objects publicly, leading to data leaks or unencrypted backup exposure.
Planned_Action: Review S3 public-access settings, bucket policies, encryption, and logging

Risk_Statement: Because data backup restorations are completely untested, a ransomware attack or physical hardware failure may encounter unrecoverable restoration files, leading to permanent data loss or prolonged core-service outages.
Planned_Action: Perform a documented restore test and assign recurring quarterly testing

Risk_Statement: Because infrastructure log pipelines are only partially monitored, malicious configuration changes or malicious access may go undetected, leading to delayed incident response and prolonged environmental exposure.
Weakness: Incomplete log visibility and review workflows
Planned_Action: Define daily high-priority CloudTrail review and route selected events to monitoring

Risk_Statement: Because the corporate incident response plan is unapproved and untested, teams may coordinate responses slowly or inconsistently during a live incident, leading to extended service downtime or compliance breaches.
Planned_Action: Approve the incident plan and run one ransomware tabletop exercise

Risk_Statement: Because new software vendors are onboarded without standard security due diligence, a compromised third-party provider may exploit data access channels, leading to vendor-driven supply chain breaches or compliance violations.
Planned_Action: Assess critical vendors and record residual-risk decisions

Risk_Statement: Because local laptop endpoints lack consistent configuration hardening and standardized telemetry collection, persistent malware may establish a quiet foothold, leading to pivot attacks into cloud assets or localized ransomware execution.
Weakness: Inconsistent endpoint telemetry and baseline auditing
Planned_Action: Apply an endpoint baseline and validate logging coverage

Risk_Statement: Because programmatic cleartext credentials are occasionally committed to source repositories, an untrusted user with code access could leak or abuse keys, leading to full production environment takeover or database access.
Weakness: Lack of automated code pipeline token checks
Planned_Action: Enable secret scanning, rotate exposed test secrets if found, and document secure secret storage
